514:t_10:9.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「It is anger, certainly, but right now he is honestly pouring out what is in his heart.」

514:t_10:10.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Surely, once he has let it all out, he will be able to laugh again like before.」

514:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...I understand, Miss $$マリーダ$$. If you are that resolved, then I, AG, will keep you company to the very end.」

514:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add the $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z that he produced this time to the unit's stock.」

514:t_10:13.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「$$バンシィ$$ is gradually growing used to him... Surely the next time we meet will be my last battle with him.」

514:t_10:15.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I'll try. After all, I am a member of $c too.」

514:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Welcome to $c! Mr. $$アスラン$$, Mr. $$レイ#pt136$$!」

514:t_10:22.en:
$$アスラン$$
「So this robot is the AG that $$キラ$$ told us about.」

514:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... Mr. $$アスラン$$... If you stare at me that much...」

514:t_10:24.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Sorry. I like tinkering with machines, so autonomous robots interest me.」

514:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What a shame for you. That I'm not a pretty-girl model like Miss $$ノノ$$, Miss $$モーム$$ and Miss $$ドロシー#bigo$$.」

514:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, come now... Aren't you famous, Mr. $$アスラン$$, as the 'Harmful Man', the lady-killer?」

514:t_10:28.en:
$$アスラン$$
「$$キラ$$! Did you tell it that!?」

514:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now, Mr. $$アスラン$$. Gathering information is more or less a dimensional merchant's basic skill.」

514:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For now, let us carry out the induction ritual for joining $c.」

514:t_10:34.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Thanks for the offer, but I'll pass. I'm not in the mood.」

514:t_10:35.en:
$$キラ$$
「So you really were bothered about being called harmful.」

514:t_10:39.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「I have no intention of falling for the sales pitch of a robot of unknown origin.」

514:t_10:40.en:
$$シン$$
「That's how it is, AG. $$レイ#pt136$$ is a pretty tough nut to crack.」

514:t_10:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Mr. $$アスラン$$, Mr. $$レイ#pt136$$... I will never give up, you know.」

514:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, this time I'm on my own for the first time in ages! Another day of full steam ahead... business, business!」

514:t_10:43.en:
$n
「Where does that obsession of yours come from, I wonder...」

515:t_001:0.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「All right! We've leaped right into $$プラント$$'s embrace!」

515:t_001:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「It's too early to celebrate, $$ラッセ$$. The operation only begins in earnest from here.」

515:t_001:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「At the moment, $$ラー・カイラム$$ and $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ are drawing $$ザフト$$ away at the first line of defense.」

515:t_001:3.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「The $$プラント$$ defense force has come out!」

515:t_002:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「There's no need to launch the mobile units. We'll only pretend to be observing, and concentrate on drawing the enemy in.」

515:t_002:1.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「Understood. Time to show off my skills!」

515:t_002:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The infiltration team has reached $$アプリリウス市$$.」

515:t_002:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(Hurry, $$シン$$. You and your friend may be the ones who decide this battle...)

515:t_003:0.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「This is bad, $$スメラギ$$! We're about to hit our limit!」

515:t_003:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I'll launch the mobile units at the last possible moment! Hold out until then!」

515:t_004:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Has $$ラー・カイラム$$ come to help us!?」

515:t_006:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「We've recovered $l and the infiltration team! Also, $$キラ・ヤマト$$ and $$シン・アスカ$$ are reportedly still in $$アプリリウス市$$!」

515:t_006:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We'll leave them to $$ルナマリア$$! Launch the mobile units!」

515:t_007:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ$$, $c... Dealing with you can wait.」

515:t_007:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「All units, begin the attack! Our target is $$アプリリウス市$$, home of $$プラント$$'s capital!」

515:t_007:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives are going after $$プラント$$, the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ collaborator!」

515:t_007:5.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Even so, civilians live there too!」

515:t_007:6.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Have you forgotten? That $$クロノ$$ ordered the suppression of the Spacenoids.」

515:t_007:7.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Damn! You mean they'll hit $$プラント$$ partly to make an example of it!?」

515:t_007:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「To think Ensign $$リディ$$ would take part in an operation like that!」

515:t_007:10.en:
$$グラハム$$
「You've fallen far, $$リディ・マーセナス$$!」

515:t_007:11.en:
$$刹那$$
「Have you lost sight of your own fight completely!?」

515:t_007:12.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, target Ensign $$リディ$$! We'll stop him, their commander, and protect $$プラント$$!」

515:t_008:1.en:
$$五飛$$
「We start by striking down the enemies approaching $$プラント$$!」

515:t_008:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Remember, Ensign $$リディ$$! We've fought for the world, with no regard for the $$地球連邦$$ or the colonies, haven't we!?」

515:t_008:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「I told you, $$バナージ$$. If you say it's for the world, then do as I say.」

515:t_008:6.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Tch! Words don't get through to him at all anymore!」

515:t_008:7.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「We have no choice but to stop him by force...!」

515:t_008:8.en:
$n
「Be careful... It seems the $$クロノ$$ Reformists are here too.」

515:t_008:10.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Is $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ going to intervene in this battle?」

515:t_008:12.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Since we can't read that man's intentions, it never hurts to be cautious.」

515:t_008:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, intercept the Conservatives while watching out for the Reformists!」

515:t_008:14.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Heh... That is just as it should be, $c.」

515:t_008:15.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$...! I'll stop you!」
